capture_method.summary: Installed build run off-screen (SDL dummy video driver, --renderer portable-sdl, --ui-scale 2, HD artwork forced on, clouds and cloud shadows off), driven and captured through its embedded MCP server (port 47815, fresh profile); ui_screenshot saves the next rendered frame at native pixels.
clean_state: Health and food bars lens off (key I, the in-game 'toggle draw information')
forbidden, clearing and guard areas erased in view just before each frame, then the frame is checked for zone-outline colours and re-shot if any remain
frames kept only while the top bar's workers stat is not negative and the event list shows at most two rows (read through ui_inspect before and after the frame), except where noted
zoom a multiple of 1/8; normal speed (1x); never paused
capture_method.aspect_16_10: captured in a 2880x1800 window at the same zoom as the 16:9 frame (fewer tiles in view); a separate run of the same recipe, so units differ in detail

files.description: 150%, a pure in-game frame taken right after the agent's last hive_program inspect in a recorded co-play session (one session per aspect ratio). The game's own Hive card at the lower left reads 'frontline-flag', Active, and the output of the standing order's latest run, which moved its war flag: {"enemies":17,"moved":[68,60]} in 16:9, {"enemies":4,"moved":[58,56]} in 16:10, with Pause, Cancel, Reports / details and Stop commander. The order's war flag (pink star) stands at that tile: 16:9, at the right-hand corner of the square lake, with red warriors along the lake shore and cyan and lime rival warriors coming in beside it; 16:10, among a group of red warriors south of the inns with a cyan rival warrior close by.
files.caption_check: A local game shared with the player's own AI agent, connected through the built-in MCP server - true: the game's interface shows the agent's standing order running in this colony and the flag it has just moved.
files.seat: player seat on colony 0, a local human player record added to the save, sharing the colony with its AI (Maxima)
player_actions_before_capture: pressed I (toggle draw information): health and food bars off
erased the colony's forbidden, clearing and guard areas in view (Flags and areas)
agent (scripted MCP client, see transcript): hive_program install frontline-flag; game_view; the standing order then placed and moved its war flag by itself
files.notes: Agent calls (transcripts in coplay-transcripts/): hive_status, game_world, hive_program install frontline-flag, game_view, then hive_program inspect after each run until one showed a move at a clean moment (16:9: 4 inspects, the first 'placed [59,60]'; 16:10: 5 inspects, the first 'placed [59,59]'). The 'agent' is a scripted MCP client (tools/coplay-session.py), not a language model; the standing order's JavaScript was written by the capture engineer. Other war-flag stars in view are the colony AI's own flags (16:9: tiles 54,65 and 63,57; 16:10: 57,60 and 56,63; listed by game_world just before the frame), not the agent's. The 16:9 session checked the card only before the frame; the card in the saved frame was checked by eye and shows the inspected output. Zones erased in view by the capture tooling; nothing else placed by hand.
